name: zimrate-page-fetcher
title: ZimRate Page Fetcher
description: Fetches web page text content for ZimRate currency rate extraction. Supports both static (Cheerio) and JavaScript-rendered (Playwright) pages.

url.title: URL
url.description: The URL of the page to fetch.

javascript.title: Requires JavaScript
javascript.description: If true, uses Playwright (Chrome) to render the page. If false, uses fast Cheerio fetcher.
